remarks: Beautiful and spacious home with plenty of room for comfortable living! The first floor features an updated kitchen, walk-in pantry, and convenient laundry room. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom downstairs, along with an additional room that would be perfect for a home office, study, or dining area. The second floor offers the remaining bedrooms and three additional bathrooms, providing plenty of space for family and guests. Enjoy ample parking with a long driveway and a two-car garage. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac street, this home offers both space and privacy.
